tests.note: vkrn is a GPOS vertical-kerning feature and must never substitute glyphs. Before the fix it carried an exact copy of the dlig ligature rules, so enabling vkrn collapsed 株式会社 into the ㍿ (uni337F) ligature.
Same defect on the Latin ligature forms: enabling vkrn replaced TEL with the T_E_L ligature glyph. T_E_L is unencoded — it is not ℡ U+2121, which this font produces from lowercase "Tel".
Positive control: the squared-form ligatures are correctly tagged dlig, and dropping the duplicated vkrn record must not remove them.
Positive control for the Latin ligature forms under their correct dlig tag.
